findings.title: mailing_list_notify bypasses unsubscribe link
findings.body: mailing_list_notify calls send_notification_email without going through notification_email, and send_notification_email now unconditionally sets unsubscribe_url: post.topic.unsubscribe_url; this is fine, but notification emails for notification_type outside replied/mentioned/quoted/posted (e.g. invited) still get add_unsubscribe_link true even though per-topic unsubscribe semantics (mute/regular) may not make sense for PM invites, since unsubscribe_url always points to topic unsubscribe regardless of context.

findings.title: unsubscribe action lacks guardian/nil checks
findings.body: The unsubscribe action does `tu = TopicUser.find_by(...)` and then calls `tu.notification_level` without checking if tu is nil (e.g., user never visited topic) or whether current_user is present (if not logged in, current_user.id raises NoMethodError). This will raise a 500 error for logged-out users or users with no existing TopicUser record, rather than gracefully handling the unsubscribe request.

findings.title: unsubscribe not permission-checked
findings.body: Unlike other actions (e.g., status, autoclose) that call guardian.ensure_can_X!, unsubscribe never verifies guardian.ensure_can_see!(topic) before mutating the TopicUser record for current_user. Although it only mutates current_user's own record, there's no check that the topic is visible to them, allowing probing of private/restricted topics' existence via this unauthenticated-looking endpoint.

findings.title: Duplicate respond_instructions placeholder
findings.body: `%{respond_instructions}` appears twice (lines 6 and 19) but message_builder's html_part only replaces the first occurrence it finds via gsub! on the whole string — actually gsub! replaces all occurrences, but respond_instructions is only computed once from template_args, so both placeholders get the same text, which may be redundant/confusing for recipients since the same instructions appear twice in rendered email with no content between except the previous discussion section somtimes missing causing duplicate instruction text directly adjacent.

findings.title: unsubscribe_url interpolation may be undefined for non-topic emails
findings.body: The unsubscribe_link translation now references %{unsubscribe_url}, but this key is only populated for topic-related notification emails (send_notification_email). Other emails using add_unsubscribe_link (e.g., digest emails via @unsubscribe_key) do not set unsubscribe_url in template_args, so I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args) would raise a MissingInterpolationArgument error or render a broken link for those templates.
